category_selection: two most frequent categories in the last 50, ties by category name; designate the less frequent as target; require >=18 dominant and >=10 target before looking at candidate labels
metric: target_category_recall_at_10_user_macro (fixed target, including at 50:50; not the natural <=20% minority definition)
limitations: Restricted to histories with enough examples of both categories; fixed target category is not necessarily a natural <=20% minority. This is a history intervention on observed clicks, not a causal user study.
